local json=require('json')
local m=manager.machine;local cpu=m.devices[':maincpu'];local r=cpu.spaces['register'];local p=cpu.spaces['program']
local f=assert(io.open(os.getenv('IM1_ANCESTRY_LOG'),'w'))
local banks
for name,index in pairs(m.devices[':'].items) do if name:match('/m_bank_regs$') then banks=emu.item(index) end end
assert(banks)
local function bank(a)return banks:read(a-0x100)|(banks:read(a-0xff)<<8)end
local entries={[33920]='action',[34731]='exit',[34764]='init',[34836]='update'}
local active={};local serial=0
local function emit(row)f:write(json.stringify(row)..'\n');f:flush()end
_G.im1_ancestry_tap=r:install_write_tap(0x18,0x19,'im1-stack-ancestry',function(a,d,mask)
 local pc=cpu.state['CURPC'].value;local old=r:read_u16(0x18)
 if mask~=0xffff then return end
 if bank(0x104)==15 and entries[pc] then
  serial=serial+1;local x={kind='entry',id=serial,callback=entries[pc],pc=pc,old_sp=old,new_sp=d,seconds=m.time:as_double(),stack={},pages={},nested=#active}
  for i=0,7 do x.pages[#x.pages+1]=bank(0x100+2*i)end
  for i=0,math.min(63,(0x1120-old)//2-1)do x.stack[#x.stack+1]=p:read_u16(old+2*i)end
  active[#active+1]={id=serial,entry_sp=old,min_sp=d};emit(x)
 end
 for _,x in ipairs(active)do x.min_sp=math.min(x.min_sp,d)end
 local x=active[#active]
 if x and d==x.entry_sp then
  emit({kind='return',id=x.id,pc=pc,sp=d,min_sp=x.min_sp,seconds=m.time:as_double()})
  active[#active]=nil
 end
end)

from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,zlib,base64,collections
from disasm import data,ctx
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;ROOT=P.parents[3]
sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
prior=ROOT/'docs/condensed/validation/bluescsi-im1-current-stack-2026-10-21.json'
s=json.loads(prior.read_text());n=s['native_graph'];q=s['irq_graph']
assert not n['issues'] and not q['issues']
assert not [r for r in n['decoded'] if r['op']=='BR']
assert not [r for r in n['decoded']+q['decoded'] if r['page']==0 and 0xdd1c<=r['pc']<=0xde9b]
assert not [r for r in q['decoded'] if r['page']==15 and 0x8480<=r['pc']<0x93b8]
build=json.loads((P.parent/'bluescsi-bug168-native-policy-2026-10-20/candidate-quiesce-v2/build-linked.json').read_text())
entry_targets={build['labels'][name] for name in ['action','exit','init','update']}
assert not [r for r in build['decoded'] if r['text'].split()[0] in ('LCALL','SCALL','LJMP','SJMP') and int(r['text'].split()[-1],16)&65535 in entry_targets]
def span(pc,size):
 off=0x4800+(pc&0x3fff);b=data[off:off+size]
 rs=[dict(pc=i.addr.offset,op=i.mnem,body=i.body,length=i.length,bytes=b[i.addr.offset-pc:i.addr.offset-pc+i.length].hex()) for i in ctx.disassemble(b,base_address=pc).instructions]
 assert sum(r['length'] for r in rs)==size
 return dict(page=0,pc=pc,file=off,bytes=b.hex(),decoded=rs)
def call(pc,target):
 r=span(pc,3)['decoded'][0]
 assert r['op']=='LCALL' and int(r['body'].split()[-1],16)&65535==target
 return r
def far(pc,target):
 x=span(pc-8,11);b=bytes.fromhex(x['bytes'])
 assert b[:4]==bytes.fromhex('a100001c') and b[4:8]==bytes([0xa1,target&255,target>>8,0x1e])
 call(pc,0xcdc6);return x
routes=[dict(name='main-update',callback='update',prefix=28,main=call(0xc81c,0xcdc6),far=[far(0xc81c,0xdd77)],returns=[0xdda0,0xcdde,0xc81f]),
 dict(name='main-action',callback='action',prefix=30,main=call(0xc811,0xde9c),far=[far(0xe0ed,0xde4e)],returns=[0xde83,0xcdde,0xe0f0,0xc814]),
 dict(name='CRT-open',callback='init',prefix=62,main=call(0xc807,0xf468),far=[far(0xf4b7,0xcf5a),far(0xcf72,0xcf82),far(0xcfea,0xdd1c)],returns=[0xdd56,0xcdde,0xcfed,0xcdde,0xcf75,0xcdde,0xf4ba,0xc80a]),
 dict(name='CRT-exit',callback='exit',prefix=62,main=call(0xc807,0xf468),far=[far(0xf4ed,0xd383),far(0xd38b,0xd3ab),far(0xd3db,0xddb2)],returns=[0xdde7,0xcdde,0xd3de,0xcdde,0xd38e,0xcdde,0xf4f0,0xc80a])]
# Each dispatcher leaves12 bytes. CDC6 contributes14 local + incoming2.
# Main-update's call is already its far wrapper, while the other routes have
# one additional main-loop return word.
for r in routes:assert r['prefix']==12+16*len(r['far'])+(0 if r['callback']=='update' else 2)
tails=[span(0xcf7f,2),span(0xd3a8,2)]
assert all(x['decoded'][0]['op']=='SJMP' for x in tails)
work=P/'native-ancestry-v4';result=json.loads((work/'result.json').read_text())
raw=(work/'ancestry.jsonl').read_bytes();rows=[json.loads(x) for x in raw.splitlines()]
entries=[r for r in rows if r['kind']=='entry'];returns={r['id']:r for r in rows if r['kind']=='return'}
assert result['passed'] and len(entries)==len(returns)
assert all(e['nested']==0 and e['old_sp']-e['new_sp']==4 and returns[e['id']]['pc']==0x947d and returns[e['id']]['sp']==e['old_sp'] for e in entries)
matched=collections.Counter()
for e in entries:
 route=next(r for r in routes if r['callback']==e['callback'])
 assert 0x1120-e['old_sp']==route['prefix']
 # Exact saved-register words vary. Check every synthetic/native return at
 # the audited frame offsets, including the final main-loop return word.
 ix={'update':[0,6,13],'action':[0,6,13,14],'init':[0,6,13,14,21,22,29,30],'exit':[0,6,13,14,21,22,29,30]}[e['callback']]
 assert [e['stack'][i] for i in ix]==route['returns'],e
 matched[e['callback']]+=1
report=dict(date='2026-10-21',firmware_sha256=sha(data),prior_validation_sha256=sha(prior.read_bytes()),
 native_result={k:v for k,v in result.items() if k not in ('entries','returns')},matched_callback_counts=dict(matched),audited_routes=routes,tail_retry_spans=tails,
 no_synchronous_browser_reentry=dict(native_graph_has_no_indirect_branches=True,native_and_irq_graphs_do_not_reach_resident_dispatchers=True,
  irq_graph_does_not_reach_browser_callbacks=True,qualification='Under the closed call graphs, declared jump-table domains and normal return/selector restoration assumptions. Arbitrary corrupted function pointers are excluded.'),
 raw_trace=dict(encoding='zlib-base64 JSONL',sha256=sha(raw),rows=len(rows),data=base64.b64encode(zlib.compress(raw,9)).decode()),
 sources={name:(P/name).read_text() for name in ['ancestry.lua','run_ancestry.py','audit_ancestry.py']},
 complete_stack_gate=False,
 limitations=['Named CRT/GB-6 routes only; additional modal/LCD/screen-transition caller ancestry and IRQ nesting/state invariants are open.',
 'Observed248-byte total is not a worst-case bound.',
 'Initial sandbox run could not connect runtime MIDI. V2 observer subtracted1 from CURPC and caught PUSH after PUSHA; rejected. V3 corrected observer passed collection routes but missed Disk options click; not accepted for native-menu handoff. OnlyV4 is used here.'])
out=ROOT/'docs/condensed/validation/bluescsi-im1-ancestry-2026-10-21.json'
png=out.with_suffix('.png');png.write_bytes((work/'native-load.png').read_bytes())
report['native_load_screen']=dict(file=png.name,sha256=sha(png.read_bytes()))
out.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(dict(callback_counts=matched,total_callbacks=len(entries),observed_total=result['maximum_observed_total'],matched_routes=len(routes),complete_stack_gate=False),indent=2))
